note: ADR 1216 slice 2: an async optimistic setter in a callback prop the child calls in its body (inline or through a spread forward) or in a local component rendered as a direct child of intrinsic elements: Chrome throws OPTIMISTIC_WRITE_BEFORE_LOAD and SC2009 is a violation. A render in an expression child that a click enables, a prop called only in the child's handler and a child inside a component's children stay uncertifiable.
